# Refunds over $500 require a district manager approval code

## Rule Statement

Every refund over $500 requires a district manager approval code, entered before the refund completes. No refund above the threshold leaves a Larkspur Supply store without one.

## Enforcement

required

## Rationale

The 2025 shrink audit traced $61k of unbacked refunds across eleven stores in two quarters, and not one of them had a second name on it. Larkspur's response to the auditors committed to a hard threshold with a named approver instead of a sampling review, because sampling review is what had been in place while the $61k went out.

## Known Exceptions

None. Vendor recalls and employee purchases were both put forward as carve-outs at the February workshop and Ruben Ortiz declined both: an exception the register cannot see is an exception nobody can count.
